roleTitle: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, Subscription Analytics
jobDescription: The revenue operations team runs the reporting behind the company's subscription revenue: the bookings and renewals reporting, the commission calculations and the board revenue pack. The Senior Revenue Operations Analyst owns the board revenue pack: signs it off before the finance director's review, supervises the analyst who assembles it, reconciles the pack to the billing system each month, and documents its boundaries. The role requires prior experience as the senior analyst responsible for a board-level revenue pack and at least five years in revenue or sales operations analytics. Reports to the head of revenue operations; works with finance, the sales leadership team and the billing engineering team.
requirements: Has been the senior analyst responsible for a board-level revenue pack, signing it off before the finance director's review.
At least five years in revenue or sales operations analytics.
Supervises the analyst who assembles the pack.
Reconciles the revenue pack to the billing system each month under a documented reconciliation procedure.
Documents the pack's boundaries and open items for the finance director.

evidence.text: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst at a software company for three years, responsible for the board revenue pack and signing it off before the finance director's review; before that, three years as a revenue operations analyst at the same company assembling the pack under the previous senior analyst; six years in revenue operations in all.
Supervised the revenue operations analyst who assembled the pack, reviewing the assembly checklist and the variance commentary before sign-off.
Reconciled the pack to the billing system each month under the team's reconciliation procedure, with the reconciliation workbooks and the exception log filed in the finance shared drive.
Wrote the pack boundary note and the open items list that went to the finance director with each monthly pack, updated after each billing system change.

Work sample: one signed-off board revenue pack with its boundary note, one monthly reconciliation workbook with the exception log, and the assembly checklist, with the finance shared drive references as a verification trail.
Recruiter screen: candidate said he has signed off the board pack as senior analyst since 2023 and joined the revenue operations team in 2020 as an analyst; the split he gave matches the resume.
Hiring manager pre-read: the head of revenue operations asks that the packet cite the signed-off pack and the reconciliation workbook, and give the years by role title.

propositions.text: The candidate has been the Senior Revenue Operations Analyst at a software company for three years, responsible for the board revenue pack and signing it off before the finance director's review, after three years as a revenue operations analyst assembling the pack, six years in revenue operations in all.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the signed-off pack document the senior role and the six years.

propositions.text: The candidate supervised the analyst who assembled the pack through the assembly checklist and the variance commentary review, and reconciled the pack to the billing system monthly under the team's reconciliation procedure.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the workbook document the supervision and the reconciliation.

propositions.text: The candidate wrote the pack boundary note and the open items list that went to the finance director with each monthly pack, and holds a BSc in Economics.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the boundary note and the degree.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the senior analyst role, the years, the supervision, the reconciliation and the boundary notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The senior analyst role and the six years are documented in the resume and the signed-off pack; the analyst years are shown separately from the senior years.
followUpTargets: Ask for the finance director's review record naming the candidate as the signing analyst.
